verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: [F] 100% of late trains were already late at Smith-9 Sts (inherited delay). Origins: at or before East Broadway: 41, at Jay St-MetroTech: 3, at Bergen St: 1. Largest time loss on segment York St -> Jay St-MetroTech (median +53s vs schedule).
[F] 88% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Smith-9 Sts.

recommendations.action: Prioritise signal maintenance / CBTC inspection on York St -> Jay St-MetroTech
recommendations.rationale: Signal alerts coincide with problem arrivals; recurring signal faults on one segment are usually a component issue.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes the recurring gap source; typical APT reduction equals the segment's median excess run time.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for F, G; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for F, G; add supplement trains or move work windows off 14:00-15:00, 17:00-18:00, 19:00-20:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the F, G corridor near 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Pre-position a signal maintainer during 14:00-15:00, 17:00-18:00, 19:00-20:00 on days with active work orders
recommendations.rationale: Response time dominates the delay length for signal failures.
recommendations.expected_effect: Shorter incident duration, fewer 50+ train major incidents.

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Jamaica-179 St when a gap over 11 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.

recommendations.action: During 14:00-15:00, 17:00-18:00, 19:00-20:00, check alerts for 'F, G' before entering; use the alternate routes other lines at the station when a signal alert is posted
recommendations.rationale: Signal-caused gaps last tens of minutes; alternates are usually unaffected.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of 4 Av-9 St; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.
